summary: Astro minimal starter project (generated via npm create astro@latest) with src/pages for routes and public/ for static assets; standard npm dev/build/preview scripts.

Complete dentist website with 'Soft Modern Wellness' design. Features: responsive navbar, hero with floating cards, 6-section services grid, about with credentials, testimonials (4.9★ rating display), compelling CTA section, comprehensive footer. Color palette: ivory, sage green, terracotta. All components use CSS-only animations for performance.

Recent fixes: SectionHeader component added and used for Services/Testimonials; global.css restored to design guide palette with nav tokens; DentistHero mobile order and CTA button wrap fixes; removed placeholder EXAMPLE.astro; improved featured service card list text contrast; BaseLayout used on index with props for navbar and padding; fonts centralized in global.css; design guide written in docs/design-guide.md.
